activation_preconditions: protected main contains the exact dispatch in DISPATCHED__AWAITING_RETURN
canonical issue title has been switched from [GCL-STAGING] to the protected [GCL-CONTRIB] title
exactly one matching GCL-LEASE-ACTIVATION/1 comment exists for dispatch_id and lease_epoch
lease_clock.rule: Staging and protection time do not consume the lease. The immutable GitHub created_at of the matching activation-marker comment is the lease start. No RESULT/1 created after start+25 minutes is admissible.

execution_semantics.requirement: The agent must not begin before the matching GCL-LEASE-ACTIVATION/1 marker exists. Substantive work must stop by 24 elapsed minutes from that marker; the remaining one minute is reserved for final return transport.

authority.mutation_rule: Lease creation, expiry, supersession, and reassignment are protected-state mutations. A GCL-LEASE-ACTIVATION/1 comment may start a protected staged lease but cannot extend, revive, reassign, adjudicate, certify, or promote it.
authority.activation_rule: A protected dispatch becomes executable only when its canonical issue has the protected [GCL-CONTRIB] title and exactly one matching GCL-LEASE-ACTIVATION/1 comment. Issue creation/staging time is not lease time.

claim_boundary: This policy governs worker allocation and evidence freshness only. It does not prove, verify, promote, or refute any mathematical claim.
